CrossMux 1.6.3 for Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 3.97 adds OTA release notes to the signed stable manifest and validates the full OTA install path from 1.6.2. There are no other firmware functional changes.

## Devices and installation

- Install over stable OTA from 1.6.2, or flash `1.6.3` from GitHub Releases if you are on an older build.
- The stable channel manifest and firmware remain on `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` releases.
- This release exercises the complete OTA download, verify, and install chain starting from 1.6.2.

## Reading and reliability

- The signed stable OTA manifest now includes `release_notes` (English bullets) written at signing time.
- The release pipeline verifies those notes in the signed global manifest before upload; the signature payload rules are unchanged.
- No other reader, settings, or networking behavior changes in this build.

## Firmware assets

- Stable builds ship as `waveshare-epaper-397-firmware.bin` with matching bootloader, partitions, boot_app0, manifests, and SHA-256 checksum files on GitHub Releases.
- Rolling tag `stable` carries the signed `waveshare-epaper-397-global-manifest.json`, now with embedded release notes for the OTA update screen.
- Normal stable OTA updates preserve books and reading data on the SD card.

## 中文摘要

- 稳定版 OTA 签名清单现包含 `release_notes`（英文更新要点），在签名时写入。
- 发版流程在上传前校验签名清单中的更新要点；签名载荷规则未变。
- 本版无其他固件功能变更，并用于从 1.6.2 验证完整 OTA 安装流程。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dezzw/crossmux/compare/1.6.2...1.6.3
